name: Drift
tagline: Runs thousands of simulated futures on your bank data to estimate whether you will reach a goal.
problem: People cannot tell whether their financial goals are realistic.
solution: Ingests account data from the sponsor's API, parses goals with AI, runs Monte Carlo simulations and shows probabilities and what-if recommendations.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter a goal and see its probability of success.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Gives a probability instead of a yes or no.

lessons: Uncertainty shown honestly is more useful than a single forecast.
